tools.name: alarmify_compare_app
tools.description: Return the Alarmify URL that compares Alarmify head-to-head with a competitor alarm or sleep app (Alarmy, Sleep Cycle, Pillow, AutoSleep, Rise, Hatch Sleep, ShutEye, Calm, Headspace, iOS Clock, Google Clock, etc.).

competitor.description: Competitor app name, e.g. 'Alarmy' or 'Sleep Cycle'.

tools.name: alarmify_download_link
tools.description: Return the canonical App Store download URL for the Alarmify iOS app. Attribution tokens preset for website traffic.

tools.name: alarmify_find_wake_up_songs
tools.description: Return the Alarmify URL that ranks the top wake-up songs for a given music artist (BPM, energy, mood from Spotify audio analysis). Useful when a user asks which songs by an artist make good alarms.

artist.description: Artist name, e.g. 'Taylor Swift' or 'Bad Bunny'.

tools.name: alarmify_how_to
tools.description: Return the Alarmify guide URL for a topic (set Spotify or Apple Music as alarm, fix sleep schedule, wake up early, heavy sleeper tips, jet lag recovery, power nap, night-shift schedule, etc.).

topic.description: Guide slug or topic, e.g. 'set-spotify-as-alarm-iphone' or 'jet lag'.

tools.name: alarmify_review_link
tools.description: Return the App Store write-a-review deep link for Alarmify so the agent can prompt the user to leave a review.

tools.name: alarmify_top_country
tools.description: Return the Alarmify URL for a country's Top 50 wake-up chart (filtered for tracks with enough energy to work as an alarm).
